name: Reference-implementation extension baseline
desc: Fork/adopt the extended reference implementation (Next.js+FastAPI+PostgreSQL+Redis/Celery, modular monolith) as the working codebase.
pre: Reference implementation accessible at the given path.
main: Codebase imported/forked; local dev environment runs via docker-compose.
err: Missing dependency/tooling halts setup; documented in LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md (base repo).
sec: Secrets never committed; .env excluded.

name: Division-aware RBAC & identity framework
desc: Deny-by-default backend RBAC enforcing division (it/overseas/global) and role on every protected route, per the base codebase's own security baseline.
main: Every protected API route validates JWT, division, and role before executing.
err: Unauthorized/wrong-division request returns 401/403, never partial data.
sec: Backend-enforced, never trust frontend role checks (base ARCHITECTURE.md).

name: Division-aware authenticated login
desc: Separate IT and Overseas login entry points; JWT access + refresh token in HttpOnly cookies.
main: User submits credentials on the correct division's login page; session established.
err: Invalid credentials rejected with generic error (no user enumeration).
sec: bcrypt password hashing; short-lived access JWT; Secure cookie flag in prod.

name: Role-based access control enforcement (UI)
desc: Frontend hides navigation/actions outside the user's role, mirroring backend enforcement (FND-002).
main: Only role-permitted navigation/actions render.
err: Role-restricted UI accessed via direct URL/API is still blocked server-side (FND-002) even if briefly rendered client-side before redirect.
sec: Frontend visibility is UX only, never the security boundary.

name: Google OAuth login
desc: Optional Google sign-in alongside credential login.
blocked_reason: PRD-AUTH-003 is PROPOSED (unconfirmed) — sourced only from the original tech-stack document, never independently re-confirmed via the Decision Register.

name: Corporate & IT marketing content
desc: Home, About, Career Paths (+detail), Real Projects (+detail), Success Stories (+detail), Business Services, Blog — public, unauthenticated content browsing.
main: Visitor browses list/detail pages.
err: Unpublished/missing content shows empty state, not an error.
sec: No PII collected.

name: Enquiry submission synced to CRM
desc: Contact/request-callback form; enquiry reaches Admin and syncs via the CRM webhook (configured for Zoho).
main: Submission creates an enquiry record; webhook fires to Zoho.
err: Webhook failure must not lose the locally-captured enquiry (retry/queue).
sec: Enquiry data is personal data — GDPR-scoped.

name: Course catalogue and detail
desc: Search/filter course catalogue; course detail (curriculum, fee, duration, certification, placement-support flags).
main: Visitor searches/filters/opens a course.
err: No results → empty state with guidance.

name: Webinar listing and registration
desc: Upcoming/past webinars listing; registration capture.
main: Visitor registers for a webinar.
err: Capacity/waitlist rule unspecified — open item.
sec: Registration data is personal data — GDPR-scoped.

name: News and gallery (CMS-managed)
desc: Published news articles and gallery items, managed via CMS/Admin panel.
main: Visitor browses; Admin publishes via CMS.
err: Empty state when nothing published.
sec: Upload malware scanning recommended (base ARCHITECTURE.md).

name: Site search, FAQ, and legal pages
desc: Cross-site search, FAQ, Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Cookie Preferences.
err: Legal pages (Privacy/Terms/Cookie) ship as explicitly-labeled non-final placeholder content only -- real legal sign-off is DEC-PRIV-001, still open.
sec: Privacy/Terms content must reflect actual GDPR posture, not boilerplate -- placeholder content must be clearly labeled non-final, never presented as final legal text.

name: Trainer/batch slot enrolment
desc: Student selects an available trainer/time-slot at enrolment; 20/slot capacity; locked once booked (~3 months).
pre: Student has selected a course/track; payment initiated or completed per business rule.
main: Student browses capacity-aware slot list and books one.
err: Booking a full slot is rejected; changing a locked slot is rejected.

name: Student dashboard
desc: Course progress, attendance, pending fees, applied jobs, upcoming assignments in one view.
main: Dashboard aggregates data from enrolment, attendance, payments, assignments.
err: A failed data source for one dashboard widget (e.g. payments) does not block the rest of the dashboard from rendering.

name: Live class access
desc: Join scheduled live class via Zoho (default) or Google Meet (retained).
main: Student joins from dashboard at session time.
err: No recording available for a session hit by the concurrency limit — accepted limitation, not a fault.

name: Assignment submission
desc: View assigned work, submit before due date, see trainer score/feedback.
main: Student submits; Trainer grades (TRN-007).
err: Submission after due date flagged, not silently accepted unless allowed.

name: Support ticket
desc: Raise and track a support ticket; Trainer/Admin resolves.
main: Student raises ticket; staff responds/resolves.
err: A ticket with no assigned staff member remains visibly unassigned, not silently lost.

name: Attendance and progress view
desc: Student views own attendance record and course/module completion percentage with outstanding blockers.
main: Student views read-only attendance/progress.
err: No attendance recorded yet for a session shows as not-yet-marked, never defaulted to absent.

name: Certificate download
desc: Download earned certificates once eligibility criteria are met.
main: Student downloads certificate (auto-generated or admin-uploaded — mechanism open).
err: Certificate unavailable before eligibility met.

name: Feedback submission
desc: Submit feedback on a course/trainer.
pre: Student is enrolled in the course/trainer being reviewed.
main: Student submits feedback form.
err: A student cannot submit feedback for a course/trainer they are not enrolled with.

name: Digital agreement / consent
desc: Review and accept a digital agreement as part of enrolment.
main: Student reviews and accepts agreement; acceptance timestamped.
err: Enrolment cannot complete without acceptance.
sec: Consent capture point for GDPR.

name: Fee payment, EMI, invoices, receipts
desc: Payment dashboard (total/paid/pending/next due), EMI/instalment timeline, invoice/receipt access — Razorpay only (Stripe removed, DEC-PAY-001 re-resolved 2026-09-03).
main: Student pays via Razorpay; invoice/receipt generated; EMI schedule tracked.
err: Failed payment does not mark fee as paid; webhook signature must verify.
sec: PCI scope minimized via hosted checkout; webhook signature verification required before accepting.

name: Profile and document management
desc: Maintain own profile (contact info; CV/portfolio fields open).
main: Student edits profile fields.
err: An invalid file type/size on document upload is rejected with a clear message, not silently dropped.

name: My Batches
desc: List of batches assigned to the authenticated Trainer only.
pre: Trainer has at least one assigned batch (ADM-003).
main: Trainer views own batch list.
err: No batches → empty state.

name: Batch detail (roster and schedule)
desc: Open a batch: student roster (capped at 20 per DEC-WF-002) and schedule/status.
main: Trainer opens batch, sees roster+schedule.
err: Roster scoped strictly to that batch.

name: Upcoming sessions and live-class join
desc: Dashboard lists upcoming sessions across assigned batches with a join link to the live class.
pre: TRN-001; batch has a scheduled session.
main: Trainer views/joins upcoming session.
err: Not-yet-joinable session shown as such, not an error.

name: Recording list and resource upload
desc: Past session recordings and course resource/notes upload, visible to enrolled Students.
main: Trainer uploads resource / recording appears post-session.
err: Missing recording (concurrency limit) shown as unavailable, not an error.
sec: Restricted upload types/sizes.

name: Assignment create and edit
desc: Create/edit assignments for a batch with due date and rubric.
main: Trainer authors assignment; visible to batch students by due date.
err: Editing an assignment after student submissions exist does not retroactively invalidate work already submitted.

name: Assessment create and edit
desc: Create/edit assessments — distinct content type from assignments, with draft/scheduled states.
main: Trainer authors assessment in Draft; moves to Scheduled to publish.
err: Draft assessment never visible to Students.

name: Submission review and grading
desc: Review assignment/assessment submissions, record score/grade and feedback.
main: Trainer grades; Student sees result.
err: Re-grading a submission overwrites the prior grade with an audit trail, not a duplicate record.

name: Attendance marking
desc: Mark per-session attendance (present/absent) for an assigned batch.
main: Trainer marks attendance per student per session.
err: Marking attendance for a session with no scheduled students returns an empty roster, not an error.

name: Q&A response
desc: View and respond to student questions raised against the Trainer's batch.
main: Trainer answers a question; Student sees the reply.
err: Only the Trainer assigned to that batch can reply; multiple replies on one question show in order.

name: User/course/batch administration
desc: Admin manages users, students, trainers, courses, batches.
main: Admin performs CRUD on core entities.
err: Deleting/deactivating an entity with active dependents (e.g. a course with active batches) is blocked or requires explicit cascade confirmation, never a silent cascade delete.

name: CRM-linked enquiry/lead management
desc: View and route enquiries/leads synced via the CRM webhook (configured for Zoho).
main: Admin views/routes enquiry.
err: An enquiry that fails to sync to Zoho remains visible and actionable in Admin regardless of sync status.

name: Batch creation and trainer assignment
desc: Create a batch, assign a trainer, set capacity (≤20/slot).
main: Admin creates batch and assigns trainer; batch becomes student-selectable.
err: Capacity exceeding 20 rejected.

name: Directory management: Students, Trainers, Employers
desc: Ongoing directory/detail management beyond initial creation.
main: Admin views/edits directory detail records.
err: Editing a Student/Trainer/Employer record never overwrites a field the acting Admin lacks permission to change.

name: Enrolment review and approval
desc: Review a student's enrolment/enquiry (post-CRM-sync) and approve into active enrolment.
main: Admin approves; student enrolment becomes active.
err: Rejected enrolment does not silently proceed.

name: Certificate administration
desc: Admin issues/uploads certificates as an alternative to auto-generation.
main: Admin uploads/issues certificate.
err: Issuing a certificate for a student who hasn't met completion criteria requires an explicit override, not silent allowance.

name: Placement Team workspace
desc: [Base role] Candidate pool, company hiring requirements, interviews, offers, placement reports.
main: Placement Team manages the domestic placement pipeline.
err: A candidate withdrawn from the pool no longer appears in active matching, but historical placement records are retained.

name: HR Team workspace
desc: [Base role] Hiring/job requirements, candidate shortlist, interview coordination — internal staff mediating corporate hiring, distinct from the new Employer role.
main: HR Team manages hiring requirements and shortlists.
err: A hiring requirement with no matching candidates shows an empty state, not an error.

name: Resources/recordings oversight
desc: Admin-level view over Trainer-uploaded resources/recordings across batches.

name: Agreement/consent oversight
desc: Admin view of student agreement/consent status.

name: Notification template management
desc: Manage notification templates and monitor delivery status.
err: Email channel only this round -- WhatsApp/SMS template management stays out of scope until NOT-002/NOT-003 unblock (Twilio credentials); build extensibly (e.g. a channel field), not email-hardcoded.

name: Roles/permission administration
desc: Admin-configurable role/permission matrix.

name: Operational-tooling cluster
desc: System settings, audit logs, data import/export, backup/restore, system health, background-job monitoring.
rbac: Super Admin (DEC-SCOPE-008 resolves the prior IT Admin/Super Admin ownership ambiguity)

name: Super Admin cross-division console
desc: [Base role] Central dashboard across both divisions: users/students/staff, programs/batches/universities/recruiters, CMS/blogs/events, leads/applications/payments, reports/notifications, roles/settings/security logs/backups.
main: Super Admin operates cross-division console.
err: A cross-division privileged action (e.g. security-log export) is itself audit-logged, per the base codebase's privileged-write audit requirement.
sec: Privileged-write audit records (base ARCHITECTURE.md).

name: Employer registration
desc: [Net-new] Company registers an Employer account — no equivalent exists in the base codebase.
main: Company self-registers.
err: Approval-before-activation workflow open — see FEATURE_QUESTIONS.md.

name: Job posting
desc: [Net-new] Employer posts open roles.
main: Employer posts a job; visible to eligible Students.
err: A job posting past its closing date is not shown to Students as open, even if the Employer never explicitly closed it.

name: Candidate profile search
desc: [Net-new] Employer searches/browses Student candidate profiles within GDPR-approved visibility limits.
main: Employer searches; sees permission-limited profile fields.
err: Fields outside approved visibility never returned to Employer.
sec: GDPR-scoped — exact visible field set is an open item.

name: Interview scheduling and shortlist
desc: [Net-new] Employer maintains a shortlist and schedules interviews with candidates.
main: Employer shortlists, then schedules an interview.
err: Scheduling conflicts (same candidate, overlapping time) are flagged, not silently double-booked.

name: Interview list and status
desc: [Net-new] Employer views scheduled/past interviews in one list.
main: Employer reviews interview list.
err: Cancelled interviews remain visible in history, not deleted.

name: Placement status tracking
desc: [Net-new] Placement status (offer/accepted/joined) tracked per interviewed candidate.

name: Destination/university/course discovery
desc: Browse countries/destinations, universities (admin-prioritized), courses, with tuition ranges.
main: User browses country/university/course listings and detail.
err: A university/course with incomplete admin-entered data (per DEC-DATA-002) shows only the fields that exist -- never a fabricated placeholder value.

name: Overseas application submission
desc: Student (existing identity) submits interest in a country/university/course.
main: Student submits interest; application enters the state sequence (OVS-003/004).
alt: Known-incomplete since DEC-ROLE-004 (2026-09-14): covers only a self-authenticating applicant. An Agent-referred applicant has no login and needs an Agent-performed equivalent -- see AGT-002's reconciliation note, not yet designed.
err: Submitting interest in the same university/course twice does not create a duplicate application record.

name: Eligibility evaluation
desc: Counselor evaluates eligibility, determining viable university/course options.
main: Counselor reviews and advances/declines the application stage.
err: Rejection/waitlist/deferral outcomes are an open item — do not invent.

name: Application status tracking and notifications
desc: Student sees current application stage at any time; notified on stage change.
main: Stage change triggers a notification and updates the Student's tracking view.
alt: Known-incomplete since DEC-ROLE-004 (2026-09-14): same gap as OVS-002, an Agent-referred applicant has no login to view this with; the Agent needs an equivalent view, not yet designed.
err: A stage-change notification that fails to send does not block the status update itself from being recorded.

name: Document upload against checklist
desc: Student uploads required documents against a checklist varying by country/university/course.
main: Student uploads; Counselor verifies (verification_status).
alt: Known-incomplete since DEC-ROLE-004 (2026-09-14): same gap as OVS-002/004, an Agent-referred applicant has no login to upload with; the Agent needs an equivalent upload path, not yet designed.
err: Unsupported file types/sizes — open item.
sec: Documents may include passports/financial evidence — least-privilege access required.

name: Scholarship listing and application
desc: Browse scholarships; apply.
main: Student applies to a listed scholarship.
err: No eligibility rule engine — listing only.

name: Events and workshops
desc: View and register interest in Overseas events/workshops.
main: User registers for an event.
err: Capacity/waitlist unspecified — open item.
sec: Registration data is personal data.

name: Visa checklist and documentation
desc: Student completes a visa-specific document checklist.
main: Student completes checklist; status tracked.
err: An unverified document does not block viewing the checklist -- only advancing past the stage that requires it.
sec: Sensitive documents — least-privilege access.

name: Visa interview preparation
desc: Student accesses visa interview preparation material/guidance.
main: Student views prep material.
err: Missing prep material for a specific country shows a clear fallback, not a broken page.

name: Visa approval status tracking
desc: Track visa approval status through to a final outcome.
main: Status updates as the case progresses (checklist → ... → decision).
err: Compliance rule: never represent EduSphere as the visa decision-maker (found in reference implementation copy).

name: Agent self-registration and approval gate
desc: Agent self-registers; account held Pending until Overseas Admin approves.
main: Agent registers; Overseas Admin approves/rejects (ADM-015).
err: Pending/Rejected Agent cannot refer students or view data.

name: Referred-student roster and status
desc: Agent views roster of referred students and each one's application status. Read-only, as shipped -- known-incomplete against DEC-ROLE-004 (2026-09-14): an Agent-referred student is never issued a login, so a companion create/manage-on-behalf-of capability is required scope, not yet designed or built.
pre: AGT-001 approved; OVS-002 applications linked via agent_id.
main: Agent views own referrals only.
alt: Not yet built (DEC-ROLE-004, 2026-09-14): Agent creates the AgentStudent referral and performs OVS-002/004/005-equivalent actions (submit application, track status, upload documents) on the referred student's behalf, since that student has no login. New Feature ID needed for this write path -- see PRD_OPEN_ITEMS.md item 68, RBAC_MATRIX.md Section 2.8, DATA_MODEL.md Section 6.2/6.8.
err: Agent never sees another agent's referrals.

name: Commission accrual (automatic trigger)
desc: Commission auto-created/marked eligible when a referred application reaches finalized+joined; amount stays admin-discretionary per application (no fixed rate, by design).
pre: AGT-002; application reaches the (to-be-mapped) joined status.
main: System auto-creates eligible commission on trigger.
err: No commission creatable before the trigger condition — extends the base codebase's manual-only creation.
sec: Extends base codebase logic — see FEATURE_QUESTIONS.md for the exact trigger status mapping.

name: Commission payout request and approval
desc: Agent claims commission; separate Overseas Admin approval required before paid — closes a gap the base codebase left open.
main: Agent claims; Overseas Admin approves payout (new endpoint).
err: No commission reaches paid without explicit Overseas Admin approval, distinct from the Agent's own claim.
sec: Net-new payout-approval endpoint — not present in the base codebase.

name: Counselor workspace
desc: [Base role] Assigned students, leads, documents, applications, visas, appointments, reports.
main: Counselor manages their assigned Overseas caseload end-to-end.
err: A Counselor cannot act on a student who is not assigned to them, even via a direct record ID.

name: University Representative portal
desc: [Base role] External partner-university portal: applications sent to their institution, offer-letter tracking, admission updates, student communication, reports.
pre: FND-002; a University partner record exists.
main: Rep reviews/updates applications sent to their university.
err: Rep sees only applications addressed to their own institution.
sec: External-partner access — least-privilege scoping required.

name: School Portal role-based access (Principal/Coordinator/Teacher/Parent)
desc: [New] Net-new build -- four school-side roles, each scoped server-side to their own institution only: Principal (read-only dashboard/stats/reports), School Coordinator (write access: create/manage students one at a time, schedule activities, track attendance, generate reports), Teacher (role code school_teacher, read-only, assigned students only), Parent (role code school_parent, read-only, own child(ren) only). Supersedes the original single-representative-login model (DEC-SCOPE-009) per DEC-SCOPE-011, resolved 2026-09-14. Service-delivery data (career guidance/psychometric/counselling), if/when built, stays with the existing Counselor role (DEC-ROLE-005), not this feature's roles.
secondary: Counselor (service-delivery data, out of this feature's scope)
pre: FND-002; SCH-003 (a School partner record and the acting account both exist, created per DEC-SCOPE-012's onboarding flow).
main: Each role logs in and sees/acts on only their own institution's data, further scoped per role (Coordinator: whole institution write access; Teacher: assigned students only; Parent: own child(ren) only; Principal: whole institution read-only).
alt: Bulk roster upload is a separate Feature ID (SCH-002). Explicitly excludes an academic results/marks module (DEC-SCOPE-010 part 2, PENDING) and whether Career Guidance/Psychometric/Counselling exist as buildable modules at all (DEC-ROLE-005 settled only who would manage that data, not whether it's in scope).
err: No role ever sees another institution's data, even via a direct record ID. Teacher/Parent additionally never see students outside their own assigned/child scope, even within the same institution.
rbac: Principal (own institution, read-only) / School Coordinator (own institution, write) / Teacher (own institution + assigned students only, read-only) / Parent (own institution + own child(ren) only, read-only)
sec: External-partner-style access -- least-privilege own-institution scoping required for all four roles, same class as UNI-001/AGT-002.

name: School Coordinator bulk student roster upload (template-download-first)
desc: [New] Net-new build -- School Coordinator downloads a fixed-format template, fills it offline, uploads it; server validates against the template schema and returns a row-level accept/reject report. Resolves DEC-SCOPE-009's original deferral reason (avoiding uncontrolled bulk writes) by construction. Roster only -- academic results bulk upload is a separate Feature ID (SCH-006, in scope, DEC-ROLE-006).
pre: SCH-001 (School Coordinator account exists and is scoped to their institution).
main: Coordinator downloads template, uploads filled file, system validates and applies row-level, returns per-row accept/reject report.
alt: A row that fails validation does not block the rest of the batch -- each row succeeds or fails independently.
err: Coordinator can only bulk-create/update students within their own institution, never another's, even via a crafted upload row.
integ: File upload -- direct multipart parse (csv module), not the generic presign-then-store flow (no separate object-storage step needed for structured row processing)
sec: Server-side validation mandatory before any row is committed -- never trust the uploaded file's own claims about itself (file type, size, row count) without independent verification.

name: School partner onboarding (Admin-created, Coordinator-seeded invites)
desc: [New] Net-new build -- Overseas Admin creates a School partner record and a seed School Coordinator account for it, both active immediately (no approval gate). The Coordinator then invites/creates Principal, Teacher, and Parent accounts for that same institution, also active immediately. No School-side self-service registration exists. Independent of the still-open School Partnership tiers question.
pre: FND-002. Overseas Admin's own division-management access (mirrors how Overseas Admin manages University partner records).
main: Overseas Admin creates School + seed Coordinator (active immediately) -> Coordinator invites/creates Principal/Teacher/Parent for the same institution (active immediately).
alt: Provisioning does not vary by School Partnership tier -- every school gets the same onboarding path regardless of commercial tier, unless a future decision says otherwise.
err: An account the Coordinator creates is always scoped to the Coordinator's own school_id, server-derived, never client-supplied. A Coordinator cannot create accounts for a different institution even via a crafted request.
rbac: Overseas Admin (create School + seed Coordinator, division-wide) / School Coordinator (invite/create Principal, Teacher, Parent -- own institution only)
integ: Invite/notification delivery (email, per NOT-001) for the three Coordinator-created accounts.
sec: Invite tokens must be single-use and scoped to one institution -- same class of concern as any other account-creation flow.

name: Career Guidance & Counselling module
desc: [New] Net-new build -- Career Counselor (new role) conducts career guidance sessions, adds counselling notes, and uploads recommendations for their assigned school-affiliated students, combining EVID-014's 'Career Awareness/Guidance' and 'Individual Career Counselling' into one role's domain. School Coordinator sees this content read-only, for their own institution only. Supersedes DEC-ROLE-005's 'existing Counselor role' framing per DEC-ROLE-006.
pre: FND-002; ADM-001 (Overseas Admin or Super Admin creates the Career Counselor account and assigns their school portfolio via the Admin console -- DEC-SCOPE-014, resolved 2026-09-14, NOT via SCH-003's invite flow, which covers only the four school-side roles).
main: Career Counselor creates/manages career guidance sessions and counselling records for school-affiliated students at any school in their own portfolio; Coordinator and Parent/Student/Teacher view read-only.
alt: Exact field list/session structure not itemized by DEC-ROLE-006 -- EVID-014's detailed proposal is DERIVED_BLUEPRINT only, not confirmed. Do not invent beyond the confirmed actor/scope.
err: Career Counselor never manages a student at a school outside their own portfolio (DEC-SCOPE-013), even via a direct record ID; School Coordinator never edits this content, only views it, for their own institution only.
rbac: Career Counselor (own school portfolio, DEC-SCOPE-013) / School Coordinator (read-only, own institution) / Parent, Student, Teacher (read-only, own scope) / Overseas Admin, Super Admin (account creation + portfolio assignment, DEC-SCOPE-014)
sec: Service-delivery content about a minor -- least-privilege access required, same class as VISA/OVS document handling.

name: Psychometric Assessment module
desc: [New] Net-new build -- Psychometric Team (new role) assigns psychometric assessments and uploads reports for their assigned school-affiliated students. School Coordinator sees this content read-only, for their own institution only. Supersedes DEC-ROLE-005's 'existing Counselor role' framing per DEC-ROLE-006.
pre: FND-002; ADM-001 (Overseas Admin or Super Admin creates the Psychometric Team account and assigns their school portfolio via the Admin console -- DEC-SCOPE-014, resolved 2026-09-14, NOT via SCH-003's invite flow, which covers only the four school-side roles).
main: Psychometric Team assigns assessments and uploads reports for school-affiliated students at any school in their own portfolio; Coordinator and Parent/Student/Teacher view read-only.
alt: Exact assessment types/report field list not itemized by DEC-ROLE-006 -- EVID-014's detailed proposal is DERIVED_BLUEPRINT only, not confirmed. Do not invent beyond the confirmed actor/scope.
err: Psychometric Team never manages a student at a school outside their own portfolio (DEC-SCOPE-013), even via a direct record ID; School Coordinator never edits this content, only views it, for their own institution only.
rbac: Psychometric Team (own school portfolio, DEC-SCOPE-013) / School Coordinator (read-only, own institution) / Parent, Student, Teacher (read-only, own scope) / Overseas Admin, Super Admin (account creation + portfolio assignment, DEC-SCOPE-014)
integ: -- Built as a plain report_url string field, not a presigned file-upload integration (DATA_MODEL.md 6.18 corrected 2026-09-14; no file-storage dependency in scope for this build pass).
sec: Psychometric report data about a minor -- least-privilege access required, same class as VISA/OVS document handling.

name: Academic Results module (Draft to Verified to Published)
desc: [New] Net-new build -- Academic Team (new role) uploads/edits academic results (subject/term/marks) for assigned school-affiliated students. A result is not visible to Parent/Student/Teacher until it passes Draft -> Verified -> Published. School Coordinator sees results read-only, for their own institution only. Resolves DEC-SCOPE-010 part 2, actor/gate per DEC-ROLE-006.
pre: FND-002; ADM-001 (Overseas Admin or Super Admin creates the Academic Team account and assigns their school portfolio via the Admin console -- DEC-SCOPE-014, resolved 2026-09-14, NOT via SCH-003's invite flow, which covers only the four school-side roles). A portfolio needs at least two Academic Team members for publishing to be possible at all (DEC-ROLE-007's same-actor restriction).
main: Academic Team uploads a result (Draft) -> a DIFFERENT Academic Team member verifies it (Verified) -> a DIFFERENT Academic Team member publishes it (Published) -> Parent/Student/Teacher can then view it. Same-actor restriction confirmed DEC-ROLE-007, 2026-09-14: the uploader may never also verify or publish their own entry.
alt: The Draft->Verified->Published gate, and its verify/publish same-actor restriction, are both confirmed (DEC-ROLE-006, DEC-ROLE-007, resolved 2026-09-14) -- no longer an open re-confirmation item.
err: A Draft or Verified (not yet Published) result is never visible to Parent/Student/Teacher, even via a direct record ID. Academic Team never edits a result at a school outside their own portfolio (DEC-SCOPE-013), even via a direct record ID. An Academic Team member can never verify or publish a result they themselves uploaded (DEC-ROLE-007).
rbac: Academic Team (own school portfolio, DEC-SCOPE-013; verify/publish restricted to a different member than the uploader, DEC-ROLE-007) / School Coordinator (read-only, own institution) / Parent, Student, Teacher (read-only, own scope, Published only) / Overseas Admin, Super Admin (account creation + portfolio assignment, DEC-SCOPE-014)
sec: Academic record data about a minor -- least-privilege access required, same class as VISA/OVS document handling.

name: Email notifications
desc: Status-change events trigger email notifications.
main: System sends email on defined trigger.
err: A failed send is retried per a defined policy (policy itself open -- PRD_OPEN_ITEMS item 13), never silently dropped.

name: WhatsApp notifications (Twilio)
desc: Status-change events trigger WhatsApp notifications via Twilio.
main: System sends WhatsApp message via Twilio on defined trigger.
err: Opt-out respected once defined.

name: SMS notifications
desc: [Retained] Status-change events can trigger SMS, alongside Email/WhatsApp.
main: System sends SMS on defined trigger.
err: Same failure-handling expectation as Email/WhatsApp -- never silently dropped.

name: Payment gateway integration
desc: Razorpay gateway integration with webhook signature verification (Stripe removed, DEC-PAY-001 re-resolved 2026-09-03).
main: Checkout session created; webhook confirms payment.
err: Unverified/failed webhook never marks a fee paid.
sec: Webhook signature verification mandatory before accepting live money (base PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST.md).

name: Native LMS module extensions
desc: Additional native LMS capability beyond already-scoped notes/assignments/Q&A/attendance/recordings/certificates.
blocked_reason: PRD-LMS-001's actual feature boundary (content authoring? sequencing? quizzes? gradebooks? SCORM?) is explicitly undefined — cannot decompose into buildable AC without inventing scope.

name: Domestic/Employer reporting
desc: Enrolment funnel, course performance, student progress, employer job activity, placement outcomes.
main: Admin/Placement Team views reports.
err: A report with no underlying data for the selected period shows an empty state, never a zero-filled fabrication.

name: Overseas reporting
desc: Application funnel by stage, agent commission report, visa-status aging.

name: Approval-gate audit trail
desc: Agent-approval (AGT-001) and commission-payout (AGT-004) actions logged with actor, timestamp, outcome.
main: Every approval action writes an audit record (base codebase already has AuditLog + audit helper).
err: An audit-log write failure must not silently allow the underlying privileged action to proceed unlogged -- fail closed, not open.
sec: Directly addresses NFR-AUDIT-001 for this specific domain.

name: GDPR consent capture and self-service export/delete
desc: Explicit consent capture at data-collection points; self-service data export/delete requests.
pre: User is authenticated and requesting their own data, or an Admin is acting on a verified request.
main: User requests export/delete; system fulfills within a defined SLA (SLA itself open).
err: Deletion respects legal/financial retention holds where applicable — retention periods still open.
sec: Legal review recommended before release, per BRD Risk R-05.

name: DigitalOcean deployment
desc: Retarget the existing Docker/Postgres/Redis/Celery workload from its native AWS setup onto DigitalOcean.
main: App deployed and reachable on DigitalOcean infrastructure.
err: A failed deployment does not silently leave production traffic pointed at a partially-updated instance.
integ: DigitalOcean (Managed Postgres/Redis/Spaces/App Platform or Droplets/DOKS — mapping open)
sec: TLS termination; DB/Redis not internet-accessible; secrets via env/secret manager (base security baseline).

name: Database migration execution and seed-data decision
desc: Run the existing Alembic migration baseline against the DigitalOcean-hosted PostgreSQL instance; decide what to do with the base codebase's (currently empty) seed data.
main: Migrations run cleanly; seed-data decision made and executed.
err: A failed migration does not leave the schema in a partially-applied state -- must be transactional/rollback-safe.
